title: Eagles rule Jonathan Greenard out for Week 1

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Eagles rule Jonathan Greenard out for Week 1
sources.description: Linebacker Jonathan Greenard said on Thursday that he feels "close" to being ready to play after missing all of training camp and the preseason with a pectoral injury, but he's not close enough to be in the lineup this weekend.
